visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a young girl with long dark hair from behind; she is leaning on a bed and looking at a tablet screen displaying the Disney character Ariel. An illustrated image of Ariel in a pink ballgown is overlaid in the center of the frame. The room is dimly lit with warm indoor lighting. (2) The girl stands in an indoor space with wooden wardrobes in the background, she points her finger and speaks with an expressive facial expression. She wears yellow patterned pajamas. Subtitles appear at the bottom. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand holding and unfolding a piece of white lace fabric with intricate floral patterns. The background is a clean white surface. (4) A woman with dark hair tied back is seen operating a white electric sewing machine. She is sewing pink fabric combined with the white lace. The setting is a home workspace with various craft supplies. (5) The woman and the young girl are together behind the sewing machine; they look into the camera, making various funny faces and pouting their lips. They eventually lean in and kiss each other's cheeks. (6) A hand snaps its fingers over a circular piece of pink fabric placed on a light-colored surface. In the next frame, the fabric has been transformed into a voluminous, layered pink skirt. (7) The woman is shown pinning a pink bodice onto a dress form mannequin. The background shows a white cat resting on the floor and a shelf filled with handbags. (8) The young girl stands next to the completed pink gown on the mannequin, holding her hands to her cheeks in a gesture of surprise and delight. She is still in her pajamas. (9) The camera pans over the finished pink gown, which features puffed sleeves, lace detailing, and a full skirt. A cartoon image of Ariel is again overlaid at the bottom right. (10) The scene shifts outdoors to a rocky coastline under a bright blue sky. The girl is now wearing the completed pink gown and a long, vibrant red wig. She sits on rocks at the edge of the ocean, with waves gently washing over her. (11) The girl plays with the water, splashing it and looking around curiously. The camera uses slow-motion and high-contrast cinematic lighting to emphasize the texture of the water and the dress.
